platformNote.INSTAGRAM: Instagram professional accounts linked to a Facebook Page. Photos, carousels and Reels.
platformNote.FACEBOOK: Facebook Pages you manage. Text, photos, multi-photo posts and videos.
platformNote.TIKTOK: TikTok creator accounts. Videos and photo posts.
platformNote.LINKEDIN: LinkedIn profiles and Company Pages (Pages need LinkedIn approval). Text, images, videos.

restrictions.INSTAGRAM: Needs a professional Instagram account linked to a Facebook Page, and a Meta app with Advanced Access (app review and business verification) for other people’s accounts. No text-only posts: they go to manual publishing. Media must be a public https address; images must be JPEG.
restrictions.FACEBOOK: Needs a Meta app with Advanced Access (app review) to publish to Pages of other people. The person must have the CREATE_CONTENT task on the Page. Reels on Facebook are not published through the API (manual).
restrictions.TIKTOK: Until TikTok audits the app, every post is private to the creator. Videos are fetched from a verified domain. No text-only posts (manual).
restrictions.YOUTUBE: Uploads cost API quota (1,600 units each, 10,000 per day by default). Videos uploaded by a Google project that has not passed Google’s audit are locked to private. Videos only.
restrictions.LINKEDIN: Posting as a person needs the “Share on LinkedIn” product; posting as a Company Page needs the Community Management API, approved by LinkedIn. Tokens last 60 days and can be renewed automatically only for approved partners.

manual.title: Publish manually
manual.text: The platform’s official API cannot publish this. Copy the text, download the files and publish it yourself, then confirm here.
manual.confirm: I published this post on the platform.

unknown.title: Retry an unknown outcome?
unknown.text: The post may already exist. If it is on the platform, mark it as published instead. Retry only if you checked and it is not there.

metrics.title: Post metrics
metrics.legend: — means the platform did not provide the figure; 0 means it reported zero.
metrics.none: Metrics have not been collected yet.

not.NOT_PUBLISHED: Metrics exist only for published posts.
not.MANUAL_PUBLICATION: This post was published manually, so TOUMA cannot read its metrics.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How each platform is set up, what TOUMA asks for and what the platforms restrict.
settings.fakeMode: This server runs the test-only platform simulator: nothing is published on real platforms.
settings.monitoring: Tokens are checked in the background: renewed before they expire where the platform allows it, and you are warned before ones that cannot be renewed expire.
settings.redirect: Redirect URI to register in the developer portal
settings.notRefreshable: cannot be renewed automatically: reconnect when it expires

reconcile.NOT_FOUND: The platform shows no matching post yet.
reconcile.AMBIGUOUS: Several posts on the platform match.
reconcile.UNAVAILABLE: The platform could not be checked.
reconcile.foundNote: Found on the platform after an unclear answer: confirmed by the platform, published only once.
